scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy && node scripts/bootstrap-deployment-secrets.mjs
scripts.deploy:local: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: biome check . && pnpm locale:check && pnpm test && tsc --noEmit

DB.description: Private ledger, financial records, chat history and staged backups. Keep production and preview databases separate.

CONVERSATIONS.description: One SQLite Durable Object per conversation; coordinates streaming and execution permissions. No external script binding.

ACCESS_ISSUER.description: Your Cloudflare Access team origin, such as https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com. Set privately after configuring Access for this Worker.

ACCESS_AUDIENCE.description: Application Audience (AUD) from the Access application protecting this Worker, including all traffic.

OWNER_SUBJECT.description: Exact Access user ID (JWT sub) of the single owner. Obtain from your own Zero Trust user details; never bind the first visitor automatically.

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional legacy environment fallback. Prefer configuring AI in owner-only web Settings after deployment.

AI_BASE_URL.description: Optional private OpenAI-compatible provider base URL. Keep provider settings server-side and configure together with AI_API_KEY and AI_MODEL.

AI_MODEL.description: Optional provider model ID. Validate tool calling and structured outputs with synthetic entries before personal use.

WECHAT.description: Optional ClawBot receiver. SQLite Durable Object keeps encrypted credentials, inbox, deduplication and polling cursor separate from business backups.

WECHAT_SECRET.description: Generated once by the deploy script as a Worker Secret. Encrypts WeChat credentials and reply context. Preserve it on redeploy; the owner only needs to scan a QR code.

CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated once by the deploy script as a Worker Secret. Encrypts web-configured AI credentials; never rotate during ordinary redeploys.
